as_of_date.description: Current athlete-local date YYYY-MM-DD passed to upstream now to resolve season boundaries; never a UTC timestamp.

athlete_id.description: Target athlete; defaults to selected athlete in coach mode, or the only athlete otherwise. Format: i12345 or 12345.

duration_seconds.description: Up to 16 duration buckets in seconds, including long efforts. Defaults to 5,15,30,60,300,1200,3600; only upstream values are returned.

include_full.description: Include raw upstream arrays and activity maps keyed by season selector when true.

season_offsets.description: Season offsets: 0=current upstream season, 1=previous, up to 10. Defaults to [0,1]; at most four unique offsets. Missing seasons remain explicitly unavailable.

sport.description: intervals.icu sport/type; defaults to Ride. Every compared curve uses this sport.
